closed_findings: Concurrent review validators use independent reservations under one durable top-level dispatch claim.
Legacy role owners atomically adopt active runs, leases, and nonterminal effects at the deployment-identity cutover.
All production lifecycle mutations capture a PR head or issue updatedAt revision and reconcile before mutation.
Publication ancestor authority works on Linux and macOS and pins the configured GitHub host independently of child GH_HOST.
Transparent wrappers cannot hide dynamic interpreters from governor resolution.
Claude visual receipts are daemon-signed and bound to HEAD plus image digest; Codex cannot mint trusted receipts.
launchd stages and rolls back the private config snapshot with its plists.
Partial-role service upgrades are rejected so every legacy writer stops before SQLite migration.
Process liveness probes run before, never inside, the SQLite dispatch-claim write transaction.

closed_findings: Armed subscription caps conservatively price observed stream usage when a final provider envelope is absent; unpriceable or usage-blind completed work retains its reservation.
systemd stops and removes current, unsuffixed, target-basename, and repository-derived predecessor units as one rollback-safe all-role cutover.
launchd unloads and removes unsuffixed predecessor jobs and restores their plists and loaded state if any new load fails.
Foreground and installed daemons export a stable deployment identity, and stop/status process discovery filters role PIDs by that identity.
Lease liveness probes run outside SQLite write transactions and reclaim only a transactionally revalidated lease identity.
The singleton lock authority is host-private and independent of configurable role state roots.
Concurrent role bootstrap serializes WAL selection and schema migration through a per-database advisory lock.
Wrapper option operands cannot obscure a governed mutation or dynamic interpreter from the advisory governor.

closed_findings: Case aliases cannot bypass imported-spend caps; distinct rotated ledger files retain every occurrence, including byte-identical files, while same-source legacy receipts remain idempotent.
Reservation replay compares the complete persisted authority and rejects conflicting or terminal replays.
Repository-alias collisions during schema v13 migration fail permanently with a typed operator-repair error instead of restart-looping.
Repository canonicalization adopts pending outbox rows and retires old world-feed membership, including late old observations.
Event-log appends are process-locked, complete short writes, and truncate fragments before a durable-outbox retry.
World observations are byte-bounded so one pathological PR cannot roll back its sibling snapshot rows.
launchd unloads every current scoped writer before replacing the shared config snapshot.
Target commands scrub ISSUE_AGENT_DEPLOYMENT_ID and repository authority is canonical across configuration, commands, claims, events, spend, and CLI selection.

closed_findings: The advisory governor rejects gh api request bodies, attached or separate field arguments, and explicit methods; authenticated mutations cannot pass as API reads.

Clean shutdown commits a restartable feed-retirement event and deletes that role's stored world membership; stopped feeds cannot remain permanently authoritative, while later observations safely reactivate the stable deployment identity.
